meta.title: Context compression tiers
meta.description: Adds a Context compression page under Settings with five automatic compaction tiers (gentle, light, standard, aggressive, max). Picking a tier pushes its thresholdRatio and retainRatio into every mounted agent preset compaction engine immediately, so no restart is needed, and stores the choice in <DSH home>/compression-tiers/settings.json. The plugin also adds four agent tools: compression_tiers reads or changes the tier and accepts optional per-route headroom overrides; compression_context reports live occupancy, the tier threshold and the room left; compression_compact queues a proactive compaction that runs after the turn and resumes the conversation by itself; github_push publishes the current work — the session working directory by default — after a network probe and a secret scan, with a 60-second push deadline and a failure family plus whatever is still local when it fails. A [context] line at the conversation tail reports the same occupancy. Every tier keeps automatic pressure compaction on, and /compact remains available to the human. The lower half of the page also edits the global rules: it reads and atomically writes the official instruction file <DSH home>/AGENTS.md (the official dsh-agent-instructions plugin injects it into later sessions), and the system prompt carries the newest 2,000-character clip; agents get no tool to rewrite that file, only a save on the page writes it. The page's Components panel manages GitHub CLI: it detects a gh on PATH and downloads a managed pinned gh 2.76.2 copy (resumable, atomic install, rollback on failure); a separate GitHub sign-in panel runs the gh auth login --web device flow for the official change-request panel, and the credential stays in gh's own store, which the plugin never reads. The Components panel keeps four managed components in one place: GitHub CLI 2.76.2, git 2.56.1 (MinGit), ffmpeg and ffprobe (the gyan.dev release build) and Python 3.11.18 (python-build-standalone). Each row detects the PATH copy and can download the managed build (unpacked into a staging directory, probed, then swapped in as a whole tree with rollback on failure); the managed copy wins and goes first on this process's PATH. All four share one configurable download root (default <DSH home>/compression-tiers) that the same panel can move as a whole. A repository selector beside the session title lists the account's repositories with gh repo list and binds one to the session; github_push then publishes to https://github.com/owner/name.git by default (it only changes the push target, never clones or edits the workspace), and the binding lives in sessionRepos in settings.json. Limitations: the tiers are designed for windows of at least 256k tokens (the official 65,536-token headroom caps smaller windows); the plugin updates preset-isolated engines and leaves the host-plane row alone; remove any other plugin that manages the same compaction engines or the two will fight over the policy; the 1.4.x sidebar repository panel is gone, and several repositories are published from each session through github_push; changing a tier updates the engines live, but a browser reload may be needed to see the page again.
